metadata.description: Community index of Claude skills for scientific work. Every entry is pinned to an exact commit and checked automatically.

plugins.name: szl-evidence-skills
plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev as an optional, fail-closed second reader for evidence triage; decisions that carry their own evidence. Same source revision as the science pack.

plugins.name: szl-science-skills
plugins.description: Eighteen offline, stdlib-only science checks: project workbench and claim ledger, dataset leakage, model evaluation with complete denominators, math and kernel checks, paired qualification, reproducibility capsules, artifact lineage, unit invariants, negative controls, analysis-plan audit, evidence gate, cross-implementation check, mutation coverage, energy receipts, session receipts and a one-page reviewer pack.
